messages:
deploy-bot: [1964501234] Deploy started: canary redwood-nlp-v3 -> 20% traffic (eu-west-1) by @olivia. Release id: rnlp-v3.3.1

olivia: Kicking off canary now. Watching latency + errors. I'll call stop/go in ~15m.

sam: Dashboard: https://metrics.internal.company/dashboards/deploys?run=1964501234 — 95p latency baseline ~120ms

jasmin: seeing 95p jump to ~380ms on /api/v1/rerank for a subset of requests, error-rate +3x on that route 

leo: could be kv-cache warming or tokenization mismatch with the new tokenizer in v3. Will check model logs for warnings/ooms

infra-oncall: infra-side: no OOMs, no node terminations, autoscaler healthy in eu-west-1

maya: running targeted smoke against rerank: ```
curl -sS -X POST https://eu-west.api.company/api/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxx' -d '{"queries":[...]}'
``` getting ~500 on ~1/10 calls from smoke run

olivia: pause rollout. Hold at 20%. Pin routing for /api/v1/rerank to redwood-nlp-v2 until we know more. @deploy-bot, please apply pin and stop further traffic shifts.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by olivia — holding traffic at 20% (eu-west-1). Action queued: pin-route /api/v1/rerank -> redwood-nlp-v2. Will report when applied.

sam: grep across model logs: `grep -i "tokenize" /var/log/models/rnlp-v3/*.log` — seeing tokenization warnings for longer inputs in ~0.6% of requests

jasmin: if pin doesn't clear errors we should rollback v3 in eu-west. prefer to avoid global rollback but will follow the safety plan.

leo: I pushed a conversion patch yesterday that might change tokenization for edge cases. Pin + extended smoke seems safest first step.

maya: started extended smoke across 10 representative prompts (varied lengths). ETA ~6m for initial results.

infra-oncall: temporarily added +1 autoscale buffer node in eu-west while we investigate to keep headroom

olivia: decision: keep rollout paused. Pin rerank route to v2, run extended smoke. If errors persist after 10m -> rollback v3 in eu-west only. I'll update release notes and the change window. @sam capture metric snapshots for postmortem.

sam: saving dashboard snapshots and setting short retention for this run, will paste links when done.

deploy-bot: Route pin applied: /api/v1/rerank -> redwood-nlp-v2. Note: other routes still on v3 at 20%. Use `/deploy resume` when cleared.

jasmin: extended smoke -> 0/100 errors on rerank, latency back near baseline. Continuing 15m monitoring.

olivia: thanks all. keeping thread open for final go/rollback. Next decision checkpoint at ts 1964502234.
